name_zh: YOLO 检测与追踪传感器

source_references.notes: File- and commit-pinned source for local Ultralytics predict/ByteTrack calls, centroid association, person-only OpenCV HOG fallback, model setup boundaries and existing tests.

known_boundaries: Real Ultralytics inference was not executed because no maintainer-approved local model artifact was supplied and online download is prohibited.
No model weight is committed or redistributed.
Recorded replay is source-compatibility evidence, not model accuracy or real ByteTrack validation.
HOG is person-only and is not capability-equivalent to YOLO.
Detector confidence is not tracking confidence, physical uncertainty, or experiment accuracy.
Image-pixel centers require independent calibration before physical interpretation.
